changeSet.author: system-fix
changeSet.comment: Corrige marcaciones incorrectas de is_deferred generadas por el script 018. Detecta postergaciones reales solo entre meses consecutivos.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE bill_account_amounts original SET is_deferred = true, status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bill_account_amounts next_month WHERE next_month.bill_account_id = original.bill_account_id AND next_month.amount = original.amount AND ( (next_month.year = original.year AND next_month.month = original.month + 1) OR (original.month = 12 AND next_month.year = original.year + 1 AND next_month.month = 1) ) );
